name: Azaperone
summary: Azaperone is a pyridinylpiperazine and butyrophenone neuroleptic drug with sedative and antiemetic effects, which is used mainly as a tranquilizer in veterinary medicine. It is uncommonly used in humans as an antipsychotic drug.

pharmacology.text: Azaperone acts primarily as a dopamine antagonist but also has some antihistaminic and anticholinergic properties as seen with similar drugs such as haloperidol.

uses.text: Azaperone is a pyridinylpiperazine and butyrophenone neuroleptic drug with sedative and antiemetic effects, which is used mainly as a tranquilizer in veterinary medicine. It is uncommonly used in humans as an antipsychotic drug.

sideEffects.en: In animals it causes sedation and a drop in blood pressure. It is rarely used in people, so human data is limited, but dopamine blocking drugs can cause stiffness, restlessness and low blood pressure on standing.
sideEffects.zh: 在動物身上它會造成鎮靜與血壓下降。它很少用於人類，因此人體資料有限，但阻斷多巴胺的藥物可能造成肌肉僵硬、坐立不安與起身時血壓偏低。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在动物身上它会造成镇静与血压下降。它很少用于人类，因此人体数据有限，但阻断多巴胺的药物可能造成肌肉僵硬、坐立不安与起身时血压偏低。

fact.en: It belongs to the same butyrophenone family as haloperidol and is used mainly on farms, under the name Stresnil, to stop newly mixed pigs from fighting.
fact.zh: 它與氟哌啶醇同屬丁醯苯類，主要以 Stresnil 之名用於農場，防止剛被混群的豬隻互相打鬥。
fact.zhHans: 它与氟哌啶醇同属丁酰苯类，主要以 Stresnil 之名用于农场，防止刚被混群的猪只互相打斗。
